title: People & Culture Business Partner
description:
**Join the creative revolution at XR!**

At XR, we're transforming how advertising gets made, managed, and delivered. As the global leader in advertising operations, we help brands, agencies, and media companies manage every stage of the advertising lifecycle through a single platform that connects production, assets, rights, delivery, and analytics.

Join a collaborative team that's redefining the future of advertising. You'll work on meaningful challenges, help shape innovative products, and make a real impact for some of the world's leading brands. If you're passionate about advertising and technology and solving complex problems, we'd love to hear from you.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a high-autonomy, solution-oriented People & Culture Business Partner to join our People team. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to key business leaders while taking full ownership of your client groups. The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and possesses exceptional problem-solving skills—someone who can step into complex scenarios, diagnose root causes, and independently navigate toward scalable solutions.

This role requires a unique balance: you will drive high-level strategic people initiatives while comfortably rolling up your sleeves to manage critical operational, administrative, and office management responsibilities. 

**Responsibilities**

**Strategic Partnership & Autonomous Problem-Solving**

* **Strategic Alignment:**
  Build deep cross-functional relationships with business unit leaders to understand operational goals and align talent strategies accordingly.

* **Independent Problem Solving:**
  Identify organizational bottlenecks, interpersonal challenges, and process gaps; autonomously develop and execute creative, end-to-end solutions.

* **Workforce Planning:**
  Partner with department leadership and Finance (FP&A) to forecast headcount needs, address skill gaps, and implement scalable workforce structures.

* **Change Management:**
  Lead and support organizational change initiatives, providing leadership coaching and actionable communication plans during business evolutions.

**Operational, Administrative, & Site Execution**

* **Day-to-Day HR Operations:**
  Directly manage operational workflows across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding execution, offboarding logistics, status changes, and system updates.

* **Data Maintenance & HRIS:**
  Maintain complete data integrity in our HR Systems (HRIS), generating routine reports, managing administrative documentation, and tracking HR metrics.

* **Policy & General Inquiries:**
  Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day employee and manager inquiries regarding policies, benefits execution, and leave administration.

* **Office & Workplace Management:**
  Oversee local office operations and facilities administration, serving as the primary point of contact for vendor relationships, office supplies, building management, health and safety protocols, and space planning to ensure a productive, welcoming physical environment for on-site and hybrid teams.

* **Health & Safety Oversight (OHSA):**
  Oversee local workplace health and safety compliance under Ontario OHSA, including coordination of Joint Health and Safety Committee (JHSC) requirements or designated worker safety representatives.

**Talent Management & Culture**

* **Performance Enablement:**
  Drive continuous performance management frameworks, goal setting (OKRs/KPIs), and talent reviews across supported client groups.

* **Career Pathways & Succession:**
  Identify high-potential talent, design development strategies, and assist leaders with succession planning.

* **Employee Retention & Engagement:**
  Analyze employee feedback (surveys, exit interviews, touchpoints) to implement impactful retention strategies and foster an inclusive culture.

**Employee Relations & Compliance**

* **Advisory & Resolution:**
  Provide objective coaching and independently investigate complex employee relations issues, performance plans, and policy interpretations.

* **Compliance & Best Practices:**
  Ensure employment practices adhere to relevant labor laws, industry standards, and internal corporate guidelines across regions.

* **Ontario Labor Standards:**
  Ensure local practices adhere to the Ontario Employment Standards Act (ESA), Ontario Human Rights Code, and PIPEDA (privacy).

* **Contract Administration & AODA:**
  Ensure compliant employment agreements (notice, termination, probation) and ensure local office practices align with Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) standards.

* Other responsibilities as assigned by management

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  3-5 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 2 years in a dedicated HRBP or strategic People Partner capacity.

* **Proven Autonomy:**
  Track record of driving projects independently from ambiguity to execution with minimal supervision.

* **Resourceful Problem Solver:**
  Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex problems, weigh risks, and implement sound, pragmatic solutions.

* **Canadian Employment Law Expertise:**
  Strong knowledge of Ontario ESA standards, human rights legislation, OHSA requirements, and contract law principles.

* **Balanced Execution:**
  Willingness and discipline to seamlessly switch between big-picture strategic thinking and detail-oriented administrative execution.

* **Industry Background:**
  Experience supporting groups within advertising technology, SaaS, media logistics, or fast-paced digital services environments preferred.

* **Communication:**
  Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence leaders at all levels.

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional certifications such as CPHR or CHRP/CHRL designation (Human Resources Professionals Association) or SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR.

* Experience navigating hybrid/remote global workforces across multiple time zones.

* Hands-on proficiency with modern HRIS platforms (Bob, Workable, etc.) and administrative workflows.

* Prior experience managing physical office spaces or facilities coordination alongside HR responsibilities in Ontario preferred.

* **Industry Background:**
  Experience supporting media, entertainment technology, SaaS, or advertising services teams preferred.

**Reporting Relationship**

* The People & Culture Business Partner reports to the VP, People & Culture.

**Location**

* Onsite or hybrid (3 days a week) in our Toronto office.

**The wonderful world of XR**

**Impactful Work:**
You'll be at the heart of a company revolutionizing the media and creative industries. From a cutting-edge platform to AI-driven insights, your work will help our clients produce and deliver world-class content to millions worldwide.

**Global Reach, Local Impact:**
With a team of over 1,100 talented professionals serving 140 markets, we blend global scale with personalized service. Join us, and be part of a diverse, dynamic team that's making waves across the globe!

**Innovation & Growth:**
We're all about pushing boundaries and staying ahead of the curve. At XR Extreme Reach, you'll be working on groundbreaking products that power TV, film, digital marketing, and entertainment.

**Creative Culture:**
We celebrate creativity and collaboration. Whether you're working in tech, media, or creative services, we foster a culture that encourages fresh ideas, innovation, and out-of-the-box thinking.

**Make a Difference:**
Here, you'll help clients tell their stories on a global stage, while ensuring their creative vision is executed with precision and style.

**Let's Redefine What's Possible**

If you're ready to elevate brand growth, connect creativity across platforms, and unlock a new era of creative intelligence, we'd love to hear from you. Pitch us your vision- and let's build the future, together. 

**Hiring Disclosures:**

* **This job posting is for an**
  ***existing vacancy***
  — we currently have an open role and will fill this position upon finding a suitable candidate
* **Annual Salary Range: $100,000 - $110,000 CAD -**
  This range represents the expected compensation for the role and includes base salary and any non-discretionary bonus components
* We use AI-assisted screening technology to help review resumes for required skills and qualifications. Final hiring decisions are always made by our human hiring team
